mechanics.claim: Incinerate releases fire in a cone in the target direction, hitting all enemies in the cone.
mechanics.quote: releases fire in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Incinerate can hit targets behind Annie if their hitbox intersects the cone.
mechanics.quote: ''Incinerate'' can hit targets behind '''Annie''', provided their radius intersects with the cone hitbox.

mechanics.claim: The damage is dealt at the end of the cast time.
